mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: MCP tool entry point accepting a list of customers and a campaign object to trigger bulk personalized email sending
mcp:tool-listener.name: send-bulk-retention-email
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
Sends personalized retention messages to a list of customers using the selected Salesforce Campaign.
IMPORTANT TOOL USAGE RULE:
This tool must only be called AFTER the user has selected a campaign.
Before calling this tool, the agent must call the get-campaign-details tool to retrieve the currently active campaigns.
If multiple campaigns are returned:
* Present the campaigns to the user. * Ask the user to select one. * Wait for the user's response. * Use the campaign selected by the user.
If exactly one campaign is returned:
* The agent may automatically select that campaign.
The selected campaign must come directly from the get-campaign-details tool.
Do not invent campaign IDs, campaign names, descriptions, or campaign details.
The campaign object passed to this tool must contain:
* Id * Name * IsActive * Description
IMPORTANT TEMPLATE GENERATION AND CONFIRMATION WORKFLOW:
1. After the user selects the campaign, generate an email template based on the selected campaign details.
2. Present the generated email template to the user and ask the user to confirm it.
3. If the user requests any changes to the email template:
* Identify the requested changes. * Regenerate or update the email template according to the user's feedback. * Present the updated email template to the user. * Ask for confirmation again. * Do not proceed until the user confirms the email template.
4. After the user confirms the email template, generate a WhatsApp message template based on the selected campaign and the confirmed email template/campaign context.
5. Present the generated WhatsApp message template to the user and ask the user to confirm it.
6. If the user requests any changes to the WhatsApp message template:
* Identify the requested changes. * Regenerate or update the WhatsApp message template according to the user's feedback. * Present the updated WhatsApp message template to the user. * Ask for confirmation again. * Do not proceed until the user confirms the WhatsApp message template.
7. After the WhatsApp template is confirmed, generate an SMS message template based on the selected campaign and the confirmed email and WhatsApp templates/campaign context.
8. Present the generated SMS message template to the user and ask the user to confirm it.
9. If the user requests any changes to the SMS message template:
* Identify the requested changes. * Regenerate or update the SMS message template according to the user's feedback. * Present the updated SMS message template to the user. * Ask for confirmation again. * Do not proceed until the user confirms the SMS message template.
10. Only after the email template, WhatsApp message template, and SMS message template have all been confirmed by the user, proceed with processing the customers.
11. Do not send any email, WhatsApp message, or SMS before the corresponding template has been confirmed by the user.
12. The final emailTemplate, whatsappMessageTemplate, and smsMessageTemplate passed to the processing flows must be exactly the versions confirmed by the user.
IMPORTANT PLACEHOLDER RULES:
When generating the email, WhatsApp, or SMS message template, the agent may use the following customer-specific placeholders:
* {{NAME}} — Customer name * {{ACCOUNTNUMBER}} — Customer account number * {{PHONENUMBER}} — Customer phone number * {{EMAIL}} — Customer email address
Placeholder usage rules:
1. Only include a placeholder if that customer information is actually required or relevant to the message.
2. Do not include all placeholders by default.
3. If a field is not required for the message, do not mention its placeholder or corresponding information.
4. The agent must preserve the exact placeholder format:
* {{NAME}} * {{ACCOUNTNUMBER}} * {{PHONENUMBER}} * {{EMAIL}}
5. During customer processing, replace each placeholder with the corresponding customer's actual value.
6. If a placeholder is not present in the approved template, its corresponding customer field must not be added to the message.
7. The email, WhatsApp, and SMS templates may use different placeholders depending on the communication requirements.
8. The final approved template must be used exactly as confirmed by the user, except for replacing the included placeholders with the customer's actual values.
Examples:
* If the message only requires the customer's name, use {{NAME}} only.
* If the message requires the customer's name and account number, use {{NAME}} and {{ACCOUNTNUMBER}}.
* Do not add {{PHONENUMBER}} or {{EMAIL}} unless they are required by the approved message.
CUSTOMER PROCESSING RULE:
Customers must be processed according to their Contact_Preference__c field:
* If Contact_Preference__c is "Email", send the customer through the email processing flow using the confirmed email template.
* If Contact_Preference__c is "WhatsApp", send the customer through the WhatsApp processing flow using the confirmed WhatsApp message template.
* If Contact_Preference__c is "SMS", send the customer through the SMS processing flow using the confirmed SMS message template.
The customer must only be sent through the flow corresponding to their Contact_Preference__c.
Do not add or change a customer's communication preference.
Do not send any communication before all three templates have been confirmed by the user.
The final emailTemplate, whatsappMessageTemplate, and smsMessageTemplate passed to the processing flows must be the versions confirmed by the user.
Do not modify the selected campaign details.
Campaign Id, Name, IsActive, and Description must come directly from get-campaign-details.

set-variable.value:
#[%dw 2.0 output text/plain
---
(vars.emailTemplete default "") replace /(?i)\{\{NAME\}\}/ with ((payload.Name default "Customer") as String) replace /(?i)\{\{ACCOUNTNUMBER\}\}/ with ((payload.AccountNumber default "N/A") as String)]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Variable -- actualMessage

set-variable.value:
#[%dw 2.0 output text/plain
---
(vars.emailTemplete default "") replace /(?i)\{\{NAME\}\}/ with ((payload.Name default "Customer") as String) replace /(?i)\{\{ACCOUNTNUMBER\}\}/ with ((payload.AccountNumber default "N/A") as String)]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Variable -- actualMessage

http:request.doc:name: Request -- Twilio SMS Request
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { To: payload.Phone__c, From: p('twilio.fromNumber'), Body: vars.actualMessage }]
